+use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
+use clap::{Parser, Subcommand, ValueEnum};
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+use std::env;
+use std::fs::{self, File};
+use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader, Write};
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+use std::process;
+
+#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
+#[command(name = "zoxide")]
+#[command(author = "Ajeet D'Souza <98ajeet@gmail.com>")]
+#[command(version = "0.9.9")]
+#[command(about = "A smarter cd command for your terminal", long_about = None)]
+struct Cli {
+    #[command(subcommand)]
+    command: Option<Commands>,
+    #[arg(short, long, action = clap::ArgAction::Help)]
+    help: Option<bool>,
+    #[arg(short = 'V', long, action = clap::ArgAction::Help)]
+    version: Option<bool>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
+enum Commands {
+    Add {
+        #[arg(short = 's', long)]
+        score: Option<u32>,
+    },
+    Edit,
+    Import {
+        #[arg(long)]
+        from: ImportSource,
+        path: PathBuf,
+    },
+    Init {
+        shell: Shell,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        no_cmd: bool,
+        #[arg(long, default_value = "z")]
+        cmd: String,
+        #[arg(long, default_value = "pwd")]
+        hook: Hook,
+    },
+    Query {
+        #[arg(short = 'a', long)]
+        all: bool,
+        #[arg(short = 'i', long)]
+        interactive: bool,
+        #[arg(short = 'l', long)]
+        list: bool,
+        #[arg(short = 's', long)]
+        score: bool,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        exclude: Option<String>,
+        #[arg(long)]
+        base_dir: Option<String>,
+    },
+    Remove {
+        path: String,
+    },
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, ValueEnum, PartialEq)]
+enum ImportSource {
+    Autojump, Fasd, Z, ZLua, ZshZ, ZLocation,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, ValueEnum, PartialEq)]
+enum Shell {
+    Bash, Elvish, Fish, Nushell, Posix, Powershell, Tcsh, Xonsh, Zsh,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, ValueEnum, PartialEq)]
+enum Hook {
+    None, Prompt, Pwd,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+struct Entry {
+    path: String,
+    score: u32,
+    last_accessed: DateTime<Utc>,
+}
+
+fn get_data_dir() -> PathBuf {
+    if let Ok(data_dir) = env::var("_ZO_DATA_DIR") {
+        return PathBuf::from(data_dir);
+    }
+    let home = env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/home".to_string());
+    let xdg_data_home = env::var("XDG_DATA_HOME").unwrap_or_else(|_| format!("{}/.local/share", home));
+    PathBuf::from(xdg_data_home)
+}
+
+fn get_db_path() -> PathBuf {
+    get_data_dir().join("db.zo")
+}
+
+fn read_db() -> HashMap<String, Entry> {
+    let db_path = get_db_path();
+    if !db_path.exists() {
+        return HashMap::new();
+    }
+    let file = File::open(&db_path).unwrap_or_else(|_| HashMap::new());
+    let reader = BufReader::new(file);
+    let mut entries = HashMap::new();
+    for line in reader.lines() {
+        if let Ok(line) = line {
+            if line.starts_with('\0') {
+                let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split('\0').collect();
+                if parts.len() >= 3 {
+                    let path = parts[1].to_string();
+                    let score: u32 = parts[2].parse().unwrap_or(0);
+                    let last_accessed = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(parts[3])
+                        .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now());
+                    entries.insert(path, Entry { path, score, last_accessed });
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    entries
+}
+
+fn write_db(entries: &HashMap<String, Entry>) {
+    let db_path = get_db_path();
+    let parent = db_path.parent().unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new("."));
+    fs::create_dir_all(parent).ok();
+    let mut file = File::create(&db_path).unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("Failed to create {}", db_path.display()));
+    for (path, entry) in entries {
+        writeln!(file, "{}\0{}\0{}\0{}", entry.score, path, entry.last_accessed.to_rfc3339()).ok();
+    }
+}
+
+fn cmd_add(score: Option<u32>) {
+    let args: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
+    let paths: Vec<&str> = args.iter().skip(2).collect();
+
+    if paths.is_empty() {
+        eprintln!("zoxide: error: the following required arguments were not provided: <PATHS>...");
+        process::exit(1);
+    }
+
+    let mut entries = read_db();
+
+    for path in paths {
+        let path = path.trim();
+        if path.is_empty() {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        let score = score.unwrap_or(1);
+        let now = Utc::now();
+
+        if let Some(entry) = entries.get_mut(path) {
+            entry.score += 1;
+            entry.last_accessed = now;
+        } else {
+            entries.insert(path.to_string(), Entry {
+                path: path.to_string(),
+                score,
+                last_accessed: now,
+            });
+        }
+    }
+
+    write_db(&entries);
+}
+
+fn cmd_edit() {
+    if !which("fzf").is_some() {
+        eprintln!("zoxide: could not find fzf, is it installed?");
+        process::exit(1);
+    }
+
+    let entries = read_db();
+    let paths: Vec<String> = entries.keys().cloned().collect();
+
+    if paths.is_empty() {
+        eprintln!("zoxide: database is empty");
+        process::exit(0);
+    }
+
+    let result = std::process::Command::new("fzf")
+        .args(["--multi", "--preview", "cat {1}"])
+        .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
+        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
+        .output();
+
+    if let Ok(output) = result {
+        let selected: Vec<String> = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout)
+            .lines()
+            .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
+            .map(|s| s.to_string())
+            .collect();
+
+        if !selected.is_empty() {
+            let mut entries = read_db();
+            for path in selected {
+                if let Some(entry) = entries.get_mut(&path) {
+                    entry.score += 1;
+                    entry.last_accessed = Utc::now();
+                } else {
+                    entries.insert(path.clone(), Entry {
+                        path,
+                        score: 1,
+                        last_accessed: Utc::now(),
+                    });
+                }
+            }
+            write_db(&entries);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+fn which(cmd: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
+    env::var("PATH").ok().and_then(|path| {
+        path.split(':').find_map(|dir| {
+            let full_path = PathBuf::from(dir).join(cmd);
+            if full_path.exists() {
+                Some(full_path)
+            } else {
+                None
+            }
+        })
+    })
+}
+
+fn cmd_import(from: ImportSource, path: PathBuf) {
+    let entries = read_db();
+    let mut new_entries: HashMap<String, Entry> = HashMap::new();
+
+    match from {
+        ImportSource::Fasd => {
+            if path.exists() {
+                let file = File::open(&path).unwrap_or_else(|_| HashMap::new());
+                let reader = BufReader::new(file);
+                for line in reader.lines() {
+                    if let Ok(line) = line {
+                        let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
+                        if parts.len() >= 2 {
+                            let path = parts[1];
+                            let score = parts[0].parse().unwrap_or(1);
+                            let now = Utc::now();
+                            new_entries.insert(path.to_string(), Entry {
+                                path: path.to_string(),
+                                score,
+                                last_accessed: now,
+                            });
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        _ => {
+            if path.exists() {
+                let now = Utc::now();
+                new_entries.insert(path.to_string_lossy().to_string(), Entry {
+                    path: path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
+                    score: 1,
+                    last_accessed: now,
+                });
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    for (path, entry) in new_entries {
+        if let Some(existing) = entries.get_mut(&path) {
+            existing.score += entry.score;
+            existing.last_accessed = entry.last_accessed;
+        } else {
+            entries.insert(path, entry);
+        }
+    }
+
+    write_db(&entries);
+}
+
+fn cmd_init(shell: Shell, no_cmd: bool, cmd: String, hook: Hook) {
+    let mut config = String::new();
+
+    if !no_cmd {
+        match shell {
+            Shell::Bash => {
+                config.push_str("eval \"$(zoxide init bash)\"\n");
+            }
+            Shell::Zsh => {
+                config.push_str("eval \"$(zoxide init zsh)\"\n");
+            }
+            Shell::Fish => {
+                config.push_str("zoxide init fish | source\n");
+            }
+            Shell::Nushell => {
+                config.push_str("zoxide init nushell | source\n");
+            }
+            Shell::Posix => {
+                config.push_str("eval \"$(zoxide init posix)\"\n");
+            }
+            Shell::Powershell => {
+                config.push_str("zoxide init powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression\n");
+            }
+            Shell::Tcsh => {
+                config.push_str("zoxide init tcsh | source\n");
+            }
+            Shell::Xonsh => {
+                config.push_str("zoxide init xonsh | exec\n");
+            }
+            Shell::Elvish => {
+                config.push_str("zoxide init elvish | .\n");
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if !no_cmd {
+        match hook {
+            Hook::None => {}
+            Hook::Prompt => {
+                config.push_str(&format!("zoxide hook {} {}\n", cmd, hook));
+            }
+            Hook::Pwd => {
+                config.push_str(&format!("zoxide hook {} {}\n", cmd, hook));
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    println!("{}", config);
+}
+
+fn cmd_query(all: bool, interactive: bool, list: bool, score: bool, exclude: Option<String>, base_dir: Option<String>) {
+    let entries = read_db();
+    let query = env::args().skip(2).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ");
+    
+    if query.is_empty() {
+        eprintln!("zoxide: error: the following required arguments were not provided: <QUERY>");
+        process::exit(1);
+    }
+
+    let results = query_db(&entries, &query, all, score, exclude.as_deref(), base_dir.as_deref());
+
+    if list {
+        for (path, _) in results {
+            println!("{}", path);
+        }
+    } else if interactive {
+        if results.is_empty() {
+            eprintln!("zoxide: no results found");
+            process::exit(1);
+        }
+        let result = std::process::Command::new("fzf")
+            .args(["--preview", "cat {1}"])
+            .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
+            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())
+            .output();
+
+        if let Ok(output) = result {
+            let selected: Vec<String> = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout)
+                .lines()
+                .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
+                .map(|s| s.to_string())
+                .collect();
+
+            if let Some(path) = selected.first() {
+                if env::var("_ZO_ECHO").unwrap_or_else(|_| "0".to_string()) == "1" {
+                    println!("{}", path);
+                }
+                std::process::Command::new("cd").arg(path).status().ok();
+            }
+        }
+    } else {
+        if results.is_empty() {
+            eprintln!("zoxide: no results found");
+            process::exit(1);
+        }
+        let path = &results[0].0;
+        if env::var("_ZO_ECHO").unwrap_or_else(|_| "0".to_string()) == "1" {
+            println!("{}", path);
+        }
+        std::process::Command::new("cd").arg(path).status().ok();
+    }
+}
+
+fn query_db(entries: &HashMap<String, Entry>, query: &str, all: bool, score: bool, exclude: Option<&str>, base_dir: Option<&str>) -> Vec<(String, u32)> {
+    let mut results: Vec<(String, u32)> = entries
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|(path, _)| {
+            if let Some(exclude) = exclude {
+                if path == exclude {
+                    return false;
+                }
+            }
+            if let Some(base_dir) = base_dir {
+                if !path.starts_with(base_dir) {
+                    return false;
+                }
+            }
+            true
+        })
+        .filter(|(path, _)| {
+            if query.is_empty() {
+                return true;
+            }
+            path.to_lowercase().contains(&query.to_lowercase())
+        })
+        .map(|(path, entry)| (path.clone(), entry.score))
+        .collect();
+
+    if !all {
+        results.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(&a.1));
+        results.dedup_by(|a, b| a.0 == b.0);
+    }
+
+    if score {
+        results.sort_by(|a, b| {
+            let a_score = a.1;
+            let b_score = b.1;
+            a_score.cmp(&b_score).then_with(|| a.0.cmp(&b.0))
+        });
+    }
+
+    results
+}
+
+fn cmd_remove(path: String) {
+    let mut entries = read_db();
+
+    if let Some(entry) = entries.remove(&path) {
+        write_db(&entries);
+        println!("Removed {}", path);
+    } else {
+        eprintln!("zoxide: {} not found in database", path);
+        process::exit(1);
+    }
+}

+fn main() {
+    let args: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
+    
+    if args.len() > 1 && (args[1] == "--help" || args[1] == "-h") {
+        println!("Usage: zoxide [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>\n");
+        println!("Commands:");
+        println!("  add     Add a new directory or increment its rank");
+        println!("  edit    Edit the database");
+        println!("  import  Import entries from another application");
+        println!("  init    Generate shell configuration");
+        println!("  query   Search for a directory in the database");
+        println!("  remove  Remove a directory from the database");
+        println!("  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)");
+        println!("  version Print version");
+        process::exit(0);
+    }
+
+    if args.len() > 1 && (args[1] == "--version" || args[1] == "-V") {
+        println!("zoxide 0.9.9");
+        process::exit(0);
+    }
+
+    let cli = Cli::parse();
+
+    match cli.command {
+        Some(Commands::Add { score }) => cmd_add(score),
+        Some(Commands::Edit) => cmd_edit(),
+        Some(Commands::Import { from, path }) => cmd_import(from, path),
+        Some(Commands::Init { shell, no_cmd, cmd, hook }) => cmd_init(shell, no_cmd, cmd, hook),
+        Some(Commands::Query { all, interactive, list, score, exclude, base_dir }) => {
+            cmd_query(all, interactive, list, score, exclude, base_dir);
+        }
+        Some(Commands::Remove { path }) => cmd_remove(path),
+        None => {
+            println!("Usage: zoxide [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>\n");
+            println!("Commands:");
+            println!("  add     Add a new directory or increment its rank");
+            println!("  edit    Edit the database");
+            println!("  import  Import entries from another application");
+            println!("  init    Generate shell configuration");
+            println!("  query   Search for a directory in the database");
+            println!("  remove  Remove a directory from the database");
+            println!("  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)");
+            println!("  version Print version");
+            process::exit(1);
+        }
+    }
